goal: Prevent node aborts and mandatory reindexing when transactions enter the mempool while loading a snapshot
Reject mempool submissions and concurrent snapshot loads while snapshot activation is in progress
agreement: Suggested blocking mempool entry during loading instead of failing activation later (fjahr)
Author updated the implementation to follow that approach and is waiting for review

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because transactions entering the mempool during snapshot validation hit an assertion failure
Terminates the process after metadata is written to disk, requiring a full reindex to recover
